items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Willy (Barell) calls Minneapolis. He scrapes some money together... Tremendous person after I found out later.

ctx.x: Yeah. Darrell Harris. Leave us stranded. Didn't leave a cent. Now, we're sitting there in the living room and eating these people's food and all that kind of thing. Giving us the go sign. We went there the first time and we looked so bad, we had our bags and everything and they refused us. I think it's a little resort town, right up the peninsula down on the lake ... so some fellow there They didn't want us recommended this young lady ... so anyhow we went down and we had a place to stay, which was important.…
part of the country. Tremendous person after I found out later. And this alto player by the name of George Johnson and he was there. So, he's a trumpet and alto saxophone player.
